module.purpose: Defines core TypeScript type contracts for Redux store, dispatch, subscription, observable interoperability, and store enhancers.
module.summary: This file establishes the type-level foundation of a Redux-like store. It declares the Dispatch function interface, Unsubscribe and ListenerCallback types for subscription management, Observable and Observer types for reactive interoperability via Symbol.observable, and the central Store interface exposing dispatch, getState, subscribe, replaceReducer, and observable methods. It also defines StoreCreator, StoreEnhancer, and StoreEnhancerStoreCreator types to support composable store enhancement. All declarations are type-only with no runtime implementation.
module.businessContext: Redux state management typing. Critical for type-safe store interactions; breakage causes unsafe dispatches and lost compile-time guarantees.

contractsProvided.name: Dispatch
contractsProvided.shape: export interface Dispatch<A extends Action = UnknownAction> { <T extends A>(action: T, ...extraArgs: any[]): T }

contractsProvided.name: Observable
contractsProvided.shape: export type Observable<T> = { subscribe: (observer: Observer<T>) => { unsubscribe: Unsubscribe }; [Symbol.observable](): Observable<T> }

contractsProvided.name: Observer
contractsProvided.shape: export type Observer<T> = { next?(value: T): void }

contractsProvided.name: Store
contractsProvided.shape: export interface Store<S = any, A extends Action = UnknownAction, StateExt extends unknown = unknown> { dispatch: Dispatch<A>; getState(): S & StateExt; subscribe(listener: ListenerCallback): Unsubscribe; replaceReducer(nextReducer: Reducer<S, A>): void; [Symbol.observable](): Observable<S & StateExt> }

contractsProvided.name: UnknownIfNonSpecific
contractsProvided.shape: export type UnknownIfNonSpecific<T> = {} extends T ? unknown : T

contractsProvided.name: StoreCreator
contractsProvided.shape: export interface StoreCreator { <S, A extends Action, Ext extends {} = {}, StateExt extends {} = {}>(reducer: Reducer<S, A>, enhancer?: StoreEnhancer<Ext, StateExt>): Store<S, A, UnknownIfNonSpecific<StateExt>> & Ext; <S, A extends Action, Ext extends {} = {}, StateExt extends {} = {}, PreloadedState = S>(reducer: Reducer<S, A, PreloadedState>, preloadedState?: PreloadedState | undefined, enhancer?: StoreEnhancer<Ext, StateExt>): Store<S, A, UnknownIfNonSpecific<StateExt>> & Ext }

contractsProvided.name: StoreEnhancer
contractsProvided.shape: export type StoreEnhancer<Ext extends {} = {}, StateExt extends {} = {}> = <NextExt extends {}, NextStateExt extends {}>(next: StoreEnhancerStoreCreator<NextExt, NextStateExt>) => StoreEnhancerStoreCreator<NextExt & Ext, NextStateExt & StateExt>

contractsProvided.name: StoreEnhancerStoreCreator
contractsProvided.shape: export type StoreEnhancerStoreCreator<Ext extends {} = {}, StateExt extends {} = {}> = <S, A extends Action, PreloadedState>(reducer: Reducer<S, A, PreloadedState>, preloadedState?: PreloadedState | undefined) => Store<S, A, StateExt> & Ext
